newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain - Grain, soybean values steady.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain - Grain, soybean values steady.

text.p: U.S. FOB Gulf grain and soybean basis offers were unchanged in quiet business, dealers said.

FOB soft red winter wheat offers were unaffected by Egypt's purchase Wednesday of 400,000 tonnes of U.S. soft red winter wheat for June and July shipment. Next week Pakistan was scheduled to tender for 378,000 tonnes of U.S. or Australian white wheat for June-July shipment.
South Korean firms seek a total of 47,500 tonnes of U.S. wheat late Thursday for July-August shipment.
The export tender lineup for corn and soybeans from the U.S. Gulf was light.
